purpose: Register a fail-closed Ica + Arequipa south-coast discovery hierarchy using official ANA hydrographic units and bounded official event evidence, without publishing unverified local geometry or operational states. v0.2 additionally reuses already-frozen official parent geometry where available and preregisters fail-closed ANA national hydrography probes for every named local child.

children.name: Quebrada Cansas
children.event_attribution_note: Official planning material documents recurrent destructive alluvial/debris-flow history. The RPAS orthomosaic and faja marginal are geometry/evidence context, not event footprints or hydraulic capacity.

territorial_events.receiver_reference: Río Ica / local Ocucaje drainage unresolved
territorial_events.statement: COEN-INDECI reports a huaico affecting transport and agriculture in Ocucaje; the retrieved report does not name the local ravine.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Do not assign the Ocucaje event to Cansas, La Yesera, Tortolita or any unnamed ravine.

territorial_events.receiver_reference: Local Río Grande name in Huancano / Pisco
territorial_events.statement: COEN-INDECI reports activation of an unnamed quebrada plus increased discharge/overflow of a locally named Río Grande, with housing, crop, road and water-network impacts.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Do not conflate the locally named Río Grande in this report with ANA Cuenca Grande UH 1372; do not create a child geometry until hydrologic identity is resolved.

children.name: Quebrada San José de Curis
children.event_attribution_note: Directly named by COEN-INDECI in the 2024-03-16 event.

children.name: Quebrada San Isidro de Macchanga
children.event_attribution_note: Directly named by COEN-INDECI in the 2024-03-16 event.

territorial_events.statement: COEN-INDECI reports increased flow in Quebrada San José de Curis and Quebrada San Isidro de Macchanga, discharging through Río Chico and Río Grande and damaging a drinking-water intake.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Do not create child geometry, outlet or threshold beyond the cited source.

children.name: Quebrada / torrentera Chullo
children.event_attribution_note: INGEMMET A7737 evaluated this torrentera after February 2026 rain-triggered geological hazards; exact event timing/outcome remains report-specific.

children.name: Quebrada / torrentera Los Incas
children.event_attribution_note: INGEMMET A7737 2026 evaluation context; do not infer identical behavior across metropolitan torrenteras.

children.name: Quebrada Añascoy
children.event_attribution_note: COEN-INDECI directly reports activation on 2023-03-20 with housing and road impacts.

children.name: Quebrada Gamarra
children.event_attribution_note: COEN-INDECI directly reports activation on 2023-03-20 with housing and road impacts.

children.name: Quebrada Panteón
children.event_attribution_note: COEN-INDECI directly reports activation in Quequeña in 2024.

territorial_events.statement: COEN-INDECI reports a huaico from an unnamed quebrada interrupting traffic in Vítor.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Do not assign this territorial event to a named Arequipa Metropolitana torrentera or create an approximate ravine.

children.name: Quebrada Ranrata
children.event_attribution_note: COEN-INDECI directly reports 2024-03-16 activation and increased Río Cotahuasi flow.

children.name: Quebrada Alca
children.event_attribution_note: COEN-INDECI directly reports activation in Alca in 2023.

territorial_events.territorial_reference: Localidad Lucha, distrito de Alca, Arequipa
territorial_events.statement: COEN-INDECI reports a huaico in the locality of Lucha; the retrieved source does not name a Quebrada Lucha.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Lucha is a territorial locality in this source. Do not create or name a child 'Quebrada Lucha' without independent hydrologic evidence.

children.name: Quebrada Umahuato
children.event_attribution_note: COEN-INDECI directly reports activation on 2024-03-08 in Choco, Castilla.

children.name: Quebrada Allachaya
children.event_attribution_note: COEN-INDECI directly reports activation in Chachas in 2024.

territorial_events.territorial_reference: Secocha / Mariano Nicolás Valcárcel, Camaná, Arequipa
territorial_events.statement: Official emergency reporting documents huaico impacts in Secocha and material in ravines, but the bounded source used here does not provide a defensible individual ravine identity.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Do not create a Secocha ravine polygon or transfer the event to an unnamed tributary until local hydrologic identity is resolved.

territorial_events.statement: COEN-INDECI reports a huaico affecting road AR-510 in sector San Andrés II; the source does not name the contributing ravine.
territorial_events.do_not_infer: Do not create a named child or outlet until the ravine identity and geometry are independently resolved.
